name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-remote-read-guard
description: A Client Remote read that never answers must not leave the page loading forever. The dsh Web plugin manager reads `remote.pluginInventory.list()` and `remote.pluginManager.listBundles()/listPlugins()` with no failure exit and no deadline: its store wraps the reads in `try/finally` alone (packages/client/ui-plugin-manager/src/client/manager-store.ts:670-707), so a rejected read leaves `status: 'loading'` forever and a read that never settles does the same, with no error and no retry button. This browser-half plugin bounds each of those reads: a read that throws, or that does not answer within a deadline, is reported through the `{ ok: false }` branch the store already handles — which is the branch that turns the page's own error and Retry UI on. Measured on @deepseek-ai/cordis 4.0.4: the namespace services expose their methods as configurable accessors, so a plugin can wrap them, and the consumer's own `ctx.remote.<namespace>.<method>()` path reaches the wrapper.
